SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE FORM 990 IS PREPARED BY A CPA FIRM AND IS THEN REVIEWED BY THE COO, GENERAL COUNSEL, DIRECTOR OF FINANCE, AND THE AUDIT COMMITTEE OF THE BOARD. IT IS THEN PROVIDED TO THE FULL BOARD PRIOR TO FILING WITH THE IRS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: EACH DECEMBER, THE CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY IS ISSUED AND PROVIDED TO ALL MEMBERS FOR REVIEW. THE POLICY IS THEN DISCUSSED AND SIGNED BY ALL MEMBERS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE COMPENSATION COMMITTEE SETS THE PRESIDENT'S SALARY AND REVIEWS AND APPROVES THE COO'S SALARY, IN BOTH CASES INFORMED BY MARKET-BASED COMPARABILITY DATA PREPARED BY INDEPENDENT COMPENSATION SPECIALISTS. ALL OTHER EMPLOYEE SALARIES ARE SUBJECT TO APPROVAL BY THE PRESIDENT, AND ARE INFORMED BY AND WITHIN MARKET-BASED COMPENSATION RANGES BASED ON ANALYSES PERFORMED BY INDEPENDENT COMPENSATION SPECIALISTS. SALARY INCREASES ARE PART OF THE BOARD'S REVIEW AND APPROVAL OF THE BUDGET.
